English: Scroll Stand
A simple wooden rack for holding scrolls and scraps of parchment, used by nomads on the move to record vital knowledge and horde decrees.
Manuscript Desk
A makeshift desk of planks and crates, providing a place for a learned nomad or scribe to produce and copy basic manuscripts among the tents.
Reading Pavilion
A large felt tent set aside for reading and study, where elders and learned guests may gather to discuss the wisdom of the ancients.
Copyists Room
A sturdy wooden enclosure, insulated against the wind, where copyists labor to duplicate scrolls and codices for the clans use.
Scribes Alcove
A small, well-protected alcove within the central encampment, reserved for trusted scribes to record treaties, annals, and histories. Requires Construction technology.
Scriptorium
A semi-permanent stone and timber structure where a staff of scribes, translators, and illuminators preserve and create works of knowledge. Demands advanced city construction.
Book Storage Hall
A specialized timber hall, climate-shielded with nomad ingenuity, for storing precious books and scrolls. Knowledge is now a true resource of the horde.
Scholars Study
A dedicated study for visiting and resident scholars, with imported lamps, writing materials, and rare parchment. The horde recruits wisdom from far and wide.
Archivists Chamber
A fireproofed, semi-permanent chamber staffed by skilled archivists. Imperial agents and clan elders alike consult the growing trove of written lore and law.
Grand Byzantine Library
A sprawling, ornate structure echoing the glory of Byzantium, a beacon of learning and unity among the nomads. Here, the wisdom of East and West is preserved for generations.
